verdict.rationale: HumanLayer offers app.humanlayer.com for controlling remote sessions and automation/cloud-visible sessions, but docs explicitly emphasize 'bring your own compute' and running the stack on your own workstation or remote workers, meaning users still provision and manage their own host/backend rather than a fully managed cloud execution backend. missing for 10: evidence of a fully managed, HumanLayer-operated compute/execution backend (no user-provisioned host required), SLAs/uptime guarantees for cloud execution, and independent confirmation of a true zero-infra managed runtime.
